fields.title: 📖 Did you cut open his heart?
fields.body:
🖋️ **The Prophet ﷺ** said:

> ***“Did you kill him after he had said ‘lā ilāha illā Allah’?”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The ghulāt intrude into intentions and hearts. The Sunnah binds the judgment to what is manifest and warns against encroachments.

immutable.source: 📝 al-Bukhārī, Ṣaḥīḥ al-Bukhārī, Kitāb ad-Diyāt, Bāb: Qawl Allah taʿālā wa-man aḥyāhā, Hadith Nr. 6872.
